messages:
maria: Quick sync — need a compact claims matrix + sales soundbites for next week's webinar and launch posts. Goal: 1-page battle claims that sales can use in live demos. Timeline: Thurs EOD.

sam: +1. Can we keep it <1 page, with a 3-row format: claim, evidence (benchmark/metric), rebuttal vs cloud providers? :thinking_face: 

jordan: Yes. Proposal:
- Latency: 20–50ms lower p50 on simple chat prompts vs managed endpoints (internal microbench)
- Cost: 30% lower token cost on typical routing with caching & batching
- Reliability: auto-fallback to smaller variant + regional routing

leah: Add security bullet for Private (VPC, KMS/HSM) vs public cloud endpoints. Enterprise customers care.

ryan: For evidence links, use:
- internal perf report: https://redwood.internal/reports/bench-q1 (placeholder)
- customer quote: "cut inference cost by ~40%" — ACME

maria: Good — we also need short rebuttals to common cloud claims: "managed cloud is simpler" -> "we give same simplicity but with predictable economics and optional isolation". Keep it one-liners.

sam: Draft snippets:
- Vs Cloud AI (hosted): "Same API experience, but predictable latencies and cost controls at scale."
- Vs LLM APIs: "We give you rollout controls, KV caching, and model pinning for production stability."
- Vs Infra Vendors: "Out-of-the-box runtime optimizations + zero-maintenance SLOs — no ops heavy lift."

jordan: Webinar hook idea: run a live side-by-side demo: same prompt to cloud-managed endpoint vs Redwood Dedicated + caching on, show p50/p95 and token spend in real time. We can use demo app + streaming.

leah: I'm on customer security posture slide and the Private deployment checklist.

ryan: I'll assemble the one-pager and the 3 tweet-length launch posts. Need copy review by @maria by Wed AM.

maria: Also map inbound routing: for prospects who ask about "fixing inference costs" route to sales-opps template + cost-savings calc. Add link to calculator: https://app.redwood.ai/calc (placeholder)

deploy-bot: deploy status: webinar landing page draft pushed to staging — build 2026.03.21_18:12

maria: Next steps: ryan drafts one-pager, sam + jordan add evidence snippets, leah security + customer quote. Check-in Tue 10am. :thumbsup:

sam: Got it. I'll add a small table with numbers and a mini graph export.

jordan: Will prepare the live-demo checklist (data, prompts, tokens cap).

leah: Pulling the legal-safe customer quote.

ryan: Draft up in /marketing/assets/quickstrike_battle.pdf and ping here when ready.

maria: Thanks all — short and punchy. If we nail the claims and live demo, we win the narrative.
